translation: Furongye (hibiscus leaf, two liang), Zijingpi (Cercis bark), Duhuo (Angelica pubescens), Nanxing (Arisaema, raw), Baizhi (Angelica dahurica, five qian each). Grind the above together into a powder, add one liang of Machixian (purslane), pound it extremely thoroughly, mix with the powder in one place, and use raw onion juice and old wine, mix and stir-fry warm, and apply. <ins>Fengkou Yao</ins> (wound-closing medicine, 封口藥) (seen in the injury of the nasal column bone) <ins>Jiexue Gao</ins> (Blood-Staunching Plaster, 截血膏) (seen in the injury of the lips and mouth) <ins>Wulong Gao</ins> (Black Dragon Plaster, 烏龍膏) (seen in the injury of the lingyun bone) <ins>Jiajian Zijin Dan</ins> (Modified Purple-Gold Pill, 加減紫金丹) (seen in the injury of the chest bone).
